hypotheses.H1: Scarcity may increase search difficulty/resource-related death; not assumed to lower final population.
hypotheses.H2: Localization may concentrate resources and encounters.
hypotheses.H3: Others may cue resources or competition; no guaranteed benefit.
hypotheses.H4: Remembered status may add information, but coarse memory stores no resource map.
hypotheses.H5: Scarcity/localization may interact; all hypotheses exploratory at eco n3.

actual_legacy: 40x30 tiles, food/water integer units, evolution600 initial each, capacity5 each, p=.02 per nonfull tile at tick start. Each trial draws legacy stream only if nonfull; success adds1. EAT/DRINK consume actual0/1, relief30, food energy20 in evolution, unchanged normalized physiological reward. A originalX, B+11 social token,C+37 valid pair, physical/vocalLRU256 unchanged.
mechanism: Scarcity scales only food/water regeneration p by one multiplier. Localization preserves initial totals600 each, shared4 fixed Chebyshev-square patches radius4, positive uniform background; weights=(1-strength)/N+strength*mask/patch_cells. Generate offers using the original nonfull-cell Bernoulli trials at scaled p, then relocate each offer among weighted nonfull recipients without rejection. Original World path unchanged E0; E1 uses exact legacy algorithm with p scaled. Geometry/placement RNGs independent; geometry shared food/water, placement RNGs separate.
supply_equality: For identical eligibility masks and seed/rates, offer counts/legacy budget RNG states match exactly; every offer realized (positive background, enough capacity). Different spatial saturation/consumption causes different eligible counts and realized budgets across ecologies. Record potential expected N*p, eligible expected, capacity-censored expectation, actual offers, realized, rejected; no assertion that equal p means equal realized supply. Resource-only audits absent/fixed/reset consumption quantify deviations.

calibration.select: First candidate satisfying manipulation/viability; no outcome benefit tuning. BaselineE0 two runs; E1 candidates bounded2 each; E2 bounded2 each; validate E3 two runs, no further search.
calibration.viability: Each candidate: population at100>=20 and final200>=10; food and water actually consumed>=20 each, decisions>=5000. Failure blocks evaluation, not a social-benefit criterion.
calibration.scarcity: Mean realized regeneration<=.8 baseline for EACH food/water; mean stocks ticks100..200 differ>=10% from baseline for at least one resource (report both directions). No assumed monotone population effect.
calibration.localization: Initial effective occupied cells<=.8 corresponding E0 for food AND water; all normalized weights positive; initial totals identical; reset-consumption audit offers/realization exact, reject0. No social effect criterion.

primary_outcomes: equal-individual acquisitions/opportunity within run (and aggregate numerator/exposure)
founder RMST to administrative horizon (death or censor flag, no survivors treated as deaths)
survival: Founders followed from0 to H, founder restricted survival is mean(min(observed death time,H)); survivors administratively right-censored H. Newborn follow-up/censoring reported separately; no naive newborn lifespan comparison.

pilot.reuse: E0 archived ecological outcomes reused/verified, necessary instrumented reruns because no actual consumption outcome fields in v074 archive.

failure_gates: Any E0 complete state/RNG/action/statistics mismatch blocks.
Any conservation/capacity/offer-realization inconsistency or nonfinite reward blocks.
Acquisitions must match aggregate food/water, all decision outcomes covered, all life records match initial+births, Qupdates/statistics agree.
All cases run to100; each has population>=10, at least5000 agent opportunities, food and water consumption>=20. Otherwise immediate collapse/insufficient exposure blocks primary.
Every reset supply audit must show exact proposal and gain equality; all capacity-censoring budgets disclosed.
No gate depends on B/C improving over A.

contrasts.interaction: (E3-E2)-(E1-E0), separately by mode, then moderation B-A and C-B. Per-seed effects, equal-seed mean/sample SD,min,max,n, no significance claims.

prediction.source_training: Selected A calibration200, passive actual B/C features; no new B/C calibration runs needed. Test actual A/B/C same-ecology first200 primary ticks; behavior-policy distribution shift reported.
prediction.model: v074 frozen hierarchical count predictor, min20,strength5; X,A;X,B,A;X,B,RD,A. Same held-out decisions, all/common support; no nuisance controls.
targets: next5 ACTUAL own-decision acquisitions, censored if fewer5; no absorbing reward padding
prediction.limits: observational action-conditioned prediction, early200 only, sparse support, independent eco n3; not causal policy value. Memory contrast holds actual B fixed.

diagnostics: Distances Chebyshev on frozen post-regeneration tick-start world; current pre-action here/nearest-visible-neighbor resource amounts exact sequential snapshot. Geometry/privileged values never passed to brains. Individuals only scalar histories while living, streamed on death/end. No detailed history by default.
stopping: Freeze selected parameters before evaluation. Do not reopen nuisance-control development or tune on primary results. No ecological benefit/attraction/cooperation/communication claim from proximity or population alone.
